description.value: Varsha Indian Kitchen is a modern Indian restaurant on Government Street in downtown Victoria, billing itself as Victoria's finest Indian restaurant. The menu blends traditional tandoor cooking — fish, prawns, paneer tikka, seekh kebab — with Indo-Chinese fusion dishes and a strong vegetarian lineup. Catering is also available, and online ordering and takeout make it convenient for cyclists passing through the inner harbour area.
